summary: Endless 3D seagull run over the Istanbul strait, built by Claude Haiku 5.5 · İstanbul Boğazı üstünde sonsuz 3D martı uçuşu, Claude Haiku 5.5 yaptı
key_features: Endless run that speeds up after the first 30 seconds; stamina refilled only by simit and fish, three feathers per run
Bridge decks and cables, ships, kites, storm clouds and a rival gull flock that steals your simit
Tailwind (x1.5), golden simit (x2) and shield feather power-ups; combo multiplier up to x5
Afternoon to sunset to a night of fireworks past mosques, the Galata tower, the Maiden's tower and yalı mansions
Three daily missions and a local top-5 score table; generated models with a procedural fallback

social.headline: Fly a seagull over the Bosphorus: snatch simit from ferries, dodge the bridge · Boğaz üstünde uç, vapurdan simit kap, köprüden kaç
